title: UnitWalk

candidates.name: UnitWalk
candidates.why: Eight letters that name the exact act: walk the unit. One spelling, easy to say once on a radio test, survives ru as a Latin brand with 22 characters of slack under Play's 30-character cap, and is not the bare category noun every incumbent already bids on. Gives up some head-term searchability on purpose so the listing is not Rental Inspection.

candidates.name: LeaseWalk
candidates.why: Compound of lease plus walk; pronounceable and on-job. Loses to UnitWalk because lease is a legal noun that drifts toward contract apps, and in ru lease does not help a landlord searching for an inspection walk.

candidates.name: RoomWalk Report
candidates.why: Carrier plus job noun keeps Report as a typed token. Loses length slack in longer locales and reads generic next to every checklist card on the SERP.

candidates.name: Deposit Walk
candidates.why: Names why the landlord cares — the deposit — which is evocative and honest. Loses because the app's job is the condition walk, not deposit accounting, and deposit apps already crowd adjacent SERPs.

candidates.name: Condition Book
candidates.why: Descriptive of the artifact. Below the 70 floor on distinctiveness and uniqueness once scored honestly against the field of inspection checklist titles.

candidates.name: Rental Inspection
candidates.why: Negative control: the bare category phrase on the SERP. Every serious incumbent already bids on these two words; a new listing with no reviews cannot own them.

rejected.name: Rental Inspection
rejected.reason: Negative control and hard reject: bare category noun pair that spends Play's strongest ranking field on the head term RentCheck and Property Inspect already own.

rejected.name: Inspection Checklist
rejected.reason: Generic checklist wording that collides conceptually with Checkbuster and every HSE audit card on the same SERP; fails distinctiveness and uniqueness.

rejected.name: Condition Book
rejected.reason: Scored 68, below the 70 floor; descriptive but not ownable enough against the inspection title field.

audience: A self-managing landlord with a few units who walks move-in and move-out themselves and needs photo-backed condition evidence that survives the report without an enterprise login.
rationale: UnitWalk wins as a short coined carrier that names the act without bidding on the category head term. LeaseWalk and RoomWalk Report were serious runners; Rental Inspection is kept as the negative control that must lose.
collisionCheck: Play search for UnitWalk and LeaseWalk was not exhaustively trademark-cleared. Search phrases used in recon returned no live title exactly UnitWalk among the measured cards on 2026-10-05. A clean Play search is not trademark clearance.
localisationCheck: en-US title UnitWalk is 8 characters (22 slack). ru-RU keeps UnitWalk as the Latin brand (8 characters, 22 slack). No emoji, no ALL CAPS, one spelling.

scoringRubric.floor: chosen 81 out of 100 with no dimension below 2.5; negative control Rental Inspection loses on distinctiveness and uniqueness

assumptionsUnverified: Trademark clearance for UnitWalk in class 9 is UNVERIFIED — no register was queried.
